# Camp Resource: Whitesprings Enclave Data Center

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Sep 9, 2025
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_97efbde8d84244928fddd18453facf3f~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

__Whitesprings Enclave Data Center__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ad9a8cab45214988b501630cc6a3e21f~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit: SugarBombs.RADS

*"It only looks more expensive on the outside."*

__Overview__

A decorative CAMP resource that passively generates electronic parts.

__Function__

**Produces**

Electronic Parts

- Power Relay Coil - 25%
- Fuse - 25%
- Sensor Module - 25%
- Enhanced Targeting Card - 25%

Production Rate: 1 item every 10 minutes, 12 seconds

Power Required: No

Lockable: Yes

__Build Information__

- CAMP Build Limit: 1 per camp
- Workshop Build Limit: 1 per workshop
- Shares Build Limit With: Enclave Data Center
- Build Menu Category: Resources > Producers
- Shelter Use: No
- Flamingo Units (CAMP Budget Cost): 1

__Crafting Requirements__

- 5x Steel
- 3x Screws
- 1x Circuitry

__Capacity__

- Storage: Holds up to 3 pounds of Electronic Parts

__How to Unlock__

- Atom Shop: Whitesprings Enclave Data Center – 700 Atoms
- Atom Shop Bundle: X Bundle – X Atoms
- Tradeable: No
- Giftable: No

__Build Restrictions__

- Cannot be built inside Shelters
- Only available while in CAMP Mode

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)

Hey there, I'm Kat, also known as Duchess!

I'm an Aussie data miner who creates guides for farming, events, and food buffs in Fallout 76.

I firmly believe that knowledge should be accessible to everyone, so my guides will always be free. However, maintaining a website and using photo and video editing software can be costly.

If you find my guides useful, here are a few ways you can support me:

- Share My Guides: Help your fellow vault dwellers by sharing my guides.

- __Follow Me on Social Media:__ Keep up with my latest updates by following me on social media.

- __One-Time Donation:__ Buy me a coffee.

- __Monthly Contribution:__ Become a regular supporter by subscribing to my Ko-fi page.

Every bit of support helps cover the costs of creating these guides and maybe even gets me a cup of coffee or three ;)

Thanks for your support!
